## What

One or two sentences on what this change does.

## Why

The problem or need. Link the issue or ADR if there is one.

## Checklist

- [ ] Title starts with the work item key, for example `#VEY-42: feat(ingestion): ...`
- [ ] Tests were written first; builds with zero warnings, all tests pass, CI is green
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs updated where relevant
- [ ] Folder `README.md`s and `AGENTS.md` still describe reality
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, or tool-specific files included
- [ ] Work item audit passed and posted on the work item
